statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = -3\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}+5\,\mathit{\vec k} through a cube of side 2 with sides parallel to the axes.
Suppose that one face of the cube is at y=0 and the opposite face is at y=2. If the face at y=0 is removed, what is the flux through the resulting surface?

static.solution:
\mbox{Flux}=0. The flux through opposite faces of the cube cancel.
If we remove the side of the cube at y=0, then the flux through the opposite face of the cube is no longer cancelled. For this face we have \vec A = 4 \vec j, so that \mbox{Flux } = (-3\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}+5\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot (4\vec j) = 20.
